en.quote: And I raised up of your sons for prophets, and of your young men for Nazarites. Is it not even thus? , O ye children of Israel? saith the LORD.
en.speaker: the LORD

he.quote: וָאָקִים מִבְּנֵיכֶם לִנְבִיאִים וּמִבַּחוּרֵיכֶם לִנְזִרִים הַאַף אֵין-זֹאת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נְאֻם-יְהוָֽה
he.speaker: אֲדֹנָי
